# Documentation archive

This folder holds **superseded / historical** documents, kept for provenance. They are
**not maintained** — do not edit them and do not rely on them for current state.

For the live documentation, see one level up in `documentation/`:

| Live doc | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `water_landing_cbf_design.md` | Canonical, continuously-maintained design: current theory, approach, assumptions, decisions. |
| `water_landing_cbf_math.md` | Formal mathematical derivations (system, HOCBFs, QP). |
| `CHANGELOG.md` | Chronological log of changes — read this to see what a collaborator did since you last worked. |

## Contents

- **`water_landing_cbf.md`** — original brainstorming-era research pitch (project origin).
  Superseded by `water_landing_cbf_math.md` (formal math) + `water_landing_cbf_design.md`.
- **`water_landing_cbf_implementation_notes.md`** — frozen 2026-06-25 implementation session
  summary. Its still-valid content (assumptions, limitations, behavioral analysis) has been
  folded into `water_landing_cbf_design.md`.
